notes.subject: תשגבני
notes.rationale: Jussive 'let it set me on high' vs indicative 'it sets me on high' (YLT); Tok Pisin keeps a declarative lean.

notes.subject: putim mi antap long sef
notes.rationale: שגב literally 'make lofty, inaccessible' — 'makim mi strong na sef' is a second reading.

translation: Tasol mi, mi man poroman na pen i stap long mi; ivesen bilong yu, Elohim, em i bai putim mi antap long sef.

tokens.gloss: na pen i stap long mi
em i bai putim mi antap long sef
